name: Quill-kin
body:
Quill-kin tend to be small of stature; standing only two to three feet tall; but they are hardy, tough and surprisingly nimble. The general coloring of Quill-kin ranges from white to light brown to black while their quills are mostly brown, tapering off to white or yellow.

The Quill-kin dialect of Woodlander is a bit slower and more drawn out than the other races that speak it, and is almost always accompanied by a sincere smile.

Quill-kin enjoy a varied diet of fruits, vegetables, insects, and small prey. They get most of their food from foraging and small family farms.

Throughout the Seven Realms Quill-kin are known for their phenomenal cooking skills, They are so skilled, in fact that many travelers and merchants making the trek between the Canine Kingdom in the west to the Ruminant Republic in the east will go out of their way to stay at their favorite Quill-kin run inn or tavern just to enjoy a few meals.

Quill-kin Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, -2 Strength: Quill-kin are hardy and nimble, but their small stature leaves them less capable of feats of strength.
Size: Small. Quill-kin gain a +l size bonus to their AC, a +l size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty to their Combat Maneuver Bonus and Combat Maneuver Defense, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth Checks.
Speed: Quill-kin have a base speed of 20 feet
Scent Block: Quill-kin have a natural ability to block their own odor. They can never be tracked or identified via scent.
Simple Life: Quill-kin are known for living a simple, sustainable lifestyle off the land. They receive the feat Self-Sufficient.
Skilled Chef: Quill-kin have an innate ability to prepare delicious meals, even with few ingredients available to them. Quill-kin gain a +2 bonus to any skill checks regarding the creation of prepared food.
Toxin Resistance: Quill-kin have inherited the toxin resistance of their ancestors. Quill-kin have a +2 to Fortitude Saves against poison.
Spiny Defense: A Quill-kin’s sharp quills help protect their body. This grants them +1 Natural Armor. In addition, when struck with an unarmed or natural attack, the Quill-kin inflict 1d4 points of piercing damage upon the attacker.
Languages: Quill-kin begin play speaking Common and Woodlander. A Quill-kin with a high Intelligence may select from the following bonus languages: Yipyap, Croak, Bleat-speak, and Shell-dancing.
Weapon Familiarity: Quill-kin are master archers, taught the way of the bow from the time they can walk. All Quill-kin are proficient in the shortbow and longbow.
Favored Class Bonuses
Alchemist: Add one extract formula from the alchemist formula list to the character’s formula book. This formula must be at least one level below the highest formula level the alchemist can create.
Barbarian: Add a +1/2 bonus to the barbarian’s trap sense
Cavalier: Add +1/2 to the cavalier’s effective class level for the purposes of determining the damage he deals when making an attack of opportunity against a challenged foe.
Druid: Add +1/3 to the druid’s natural armor bonus when using wild shape.
Fighter: Add +l to the fighter’s CMD when resisting a bull rush or trip
Inquisitor: Add a +1/2 bonus on Intimidate checks and Knowledge checks to identify creatures
Monk: Add +l to the monk’s CMD when resisting a grapple and +1/2 to the number of stunning attacks he can attempt per day.
Ranger: Add +l skill rank to the ranger’s animal companion. If the ranger ever replaces his companion, the new companion gains these bonus skill ranks.
Witch: Add +1 skill rank to the witch’s familiar. If the half-ore ever replaces her familiar, the new familiar gains these bonus skill ranks.
Wizard: Select one arcane school power at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + the wizard’s Intelligence modifier. The wizard adds +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that arcane school power.
